description: This file defines the 'MethodSignatureComparer' class, which implements comparison and equality logic for method symbols within the Orleans code generator, specifically comparing method signatures based on name, type arguments, and parameter types.

classes.name: MethodSignatureComparer
classes.description: A sealed class implementing comparison and equality checks for method symbols based on their signatures, used within the Orleans code generator.

methods.name: Equals
methods.description: Determines if two method symbols have the same signature by comparing their names, type arguments, and parameter types.

methods.name: GetHashCode
methods.description: Computes a hash code for a method symbol based on its name, type arguments, and parameter types.

methods.name: Compare
methods.description: Provides a comparison between two method symbols, ordering them based on name, type arguments, and parameter types.
